comment: kiln.characters: the game's CharacterId in the player record. The record setup called by AddPlayer copies GameMessageLoginRequest.characterId (+0x10c of the login message) to record +0x50; the game's known_users code compares the same field. Evidence: docs/re/characters.md. The bytes are identical on the servers 1273043, 1285601, 1287369 and the client 26430625.
